hypothesis: Closing supervision under every optimal successor distinguishes missing downstream decisions from optimization failure; free coordinates and a shared encoder start from the same Q and learn only relational labels.
selection: Minimum complete training Huber plus rank_weight * full soft ranking CE; no heldout selection; report best and last. Same fixed labels, initial Q, optimizer family and update budget. Equal learning rates do not guarantee equal functional step sizes across parameterizations, so record actual Q movement.
scope: Finite feasible relational diagnostic. Every optimal successor of each supervised state-goal decision is terminal or another supervised decision. Include all six candidates without restricting action choice. Stop both covered-route evaluations at the first unsupported decision. Free coordinates cannot represent unseen states; heldout common-left poses are evaluated only for the encoder and reuse the same relation template.
followup: Interpret the matched diagnostic before expanding training. No automatic full-cube experiment.
